info.title: InvoiceCraftly Developer Document API
info.description: Beta API for generating invoice PDFs, checking EN16931-core readiness, and returning EN16931-core UBL/XML. Structured output is not a Peppol BIS artifact and does not perform network delivery.

post.description: Generate a print-ready invoice PDF using the currently supported Ledger template. The beta supports invoice documents only.

X-Render-Duration-Ms.description: Render duration when supplied by the rendering service.

post.description: Return deterministic EN16931-core readiness diagnostics. This endpoint does not generate XML.
Return readiness diagnostics and, when ready, an EN16931-core UBL/XML artifact. This is not a Peppol BIS artifact and does not perform network delivery.

200.description: Readiness result plus XML artifact when ready.
